name: kv_store_distributed_mooncake
label: Distributed (embedded)
description: Mooncake KV cache in embedded mode — each GPU contributes CPU DRAM (global_segment_size) to the cache pool. A single instance uses it as a CPU offload tier; at 2+ instances a cache_aware vllm-router shares the pool, routing prefix-matched prompts to the same instance. A lightweight mooncake_master coordinates the pool; no separate store process needed.

mooncake_master.command:
# Reachable by every instance as $MOONCAKE_MASTER_IP:50051.
# 30s KV lease; eviction starts at 95% pool usage and frees 10% per pass.
mooncake_master \
  -rpc_port=50051 \
  -rpc_thread_num=4 \
  -default_kv_lease_ttl=30000 \
  -eviction_high_watermark_ratio=0.95 \
  -eviction_ratio=0.1 \
  -logtostderr
mooncake_master.description: Lightweight metadata coordinator. One instance per cluster.

mooncake_vllm_config.note:
Same file on every instance node. global_segment_size is per GPU (not per
node) — size it so the total across all GPUs fits in the host RAM you can pin.
device_name "" auto-selects RDMA NICs by GPU-NIC PCIe/NUMA affinity.
